---
title: "Automated batch simulation"
lang: en
---
The **Scen** worksheet supports automated simulations across multiple variants. Prepare and verify the input variants before running a batch.

**Excel location:** [Scen]{.excel-menu .darkred} worksheet.

::: {.excel-operation}
### Batch workflow
1. Create and save the input variants in [Variant Management](variants.qmd).
2. Select the required scenarios in Scen.
3. Run the batch calculation and wait for the simulation to complete.
4. Check completion status, scenario names and result coverage.
5. Compare the outputs in [Results](results.qmd) or the [variant comparison](comparison.qmd).
:::

::: {.pending}
**Current Scen view required:** column names, selection controls and execution status have not been verified against the current workbook. The training material confirms batch simulation but does not establish the present click sequence.
:::

Document the tool version, scenario selection and any failed or incomplete runs. Batch outputs are only comparable when system boundaries and input assumptions are consistent.

Source: [Training, slide 33](../downloads/schulung.pdf).
